title: Restaurant Franchise Opportunity
name: Lorenzo & Kakalamba, 1 Franchisee, Est'd in 2020, Belgrade HQ
description: Lorenzo & Kakalamba is a family restaurant in Serbia offering a distinctive combination of traditional Florentine and Pirot cuisine with contemporary international dishes. The concept combines authentic culinary traditions with a unique, immersive ambience inspired by Renaissance Italy and southern Serbia. The promoter and restaurant owner is a professionally trained chef who graduated from the Apicius Academy in Florence and became a Master Chef of Tuscan cuisine, with additional training from chefs in Florence, London, and Amsterdam. The restaurant has gained recognition for its culinary and tourism positioning, including the prestigious Ambassador Luce title from Tuscan wine house Luce della Vite. Its competitive differentiation lies in its distinctive cuisine, strong family-oriented brand story, premium Italian product associations, and highly recognizable restaurant experience. The business generates revenue primarily through dine-in food and beverage sales. For an investor or franchise partner, the established concept, culinary expertise, brand recognition, differentiated positioning, and potential to replicate the Florentine-Pirot dining experience in suitable markets provide a strong foundation for expansion. Operates with a valid trade and food license.
